name: flowgraph
description: Grafy przepływów z plików YAML: silnik, edytor WYSIWYG, konwerter Mermaid

scripts.build: ./flowgraph.py editor && for f in examples/*.yml; do ./flowgraph.py render "$f" -o "dist/examples/$(basename "${f%.yml}").html" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build-app: npm run build && cd app && npm run build
